policy.third_language: Entire row NA, including identified third-language content written in Latin script.
policy.english_categories: Named entities, brands, abbreviations and loanwords count as English and may form the only English content of a valid bilingual row.
policy.misspellings: Recognizable English misspellings and concatenations count as English without rewriting or retokenizing the original sentence.
policy.uncertain_forms: Ask the user for an explicit row-specific decision before inclusion.
policy.contact_strings: Preserve existing English tokenization, including em in em@160 and one token for pn-19.
policy.welch_test: Retain the usual Welch t-test variance definition; descriptive SD ddof=0 does not change the test.

review_scope: Assistant review of all distinct Latin/alphanumeric surface word forms across six corpora, plus original sentence contexts for exceptional forms and all 500 Llama rows. This is a frozen lexical review, not an automatic semantic language identifier.
